title: P0: restore /issues route on bucket-foundation Nucleus instance
description: The bucket-foundation Nucleus pod returns 404 text/plain for GET /issues despite nginx routing the path correctly. All bd-remote create / list / ready calls fail. Either the pod image was deployed without the issues handler, or the route was renamed. Diagnose, fix, and update CLAUDE.md / .beads/remote.json to reflect the working path. Until this is unblocked, every other bead in the polingual roadmap has to be tracked in ROADMAP.md instead of the real bead instance. Acceptance: bd-remote ready returns a JSON list (even if empty) without errors.

title: P1: extract Wiktionary translations: arrays into polingual.photon_edges
description: Wiktionary's translations: arrays on English-and-others entries already encode the cross-language translation graph. Re-parse the cached JSONLs (~/agfarms/_intake/photons/kaikki-cache/) and emit edges where each (src_id, predicate="translates", dst_id) row maps an English photon to its target-language equivalent. Create new table polingual.photon_edges (src_id text, predicate text, dst_id text, payload jsonb, PRIMARY KEY (src_id, predicate, dst_id)) with GIN indexes on src_id, dst_id, predicate. Symmetric: also add the reverse edge (target -> source) when the destination photon exists in the table. Acceptance: SELECT count(*) FROM polingual.photon_edges WHERE predicate='translates' >= 1,000,000.

title: P1: GET /api/photon/<id>/translations endpoint
description: New Next.js route handler at polingual/src/app/api/photon/[id]/translations/route.ts. Returns { id, translations: [{ lang, photons: [{ id, surface, meaning_en, ipa, gloss }] }] } grouped by target language. Reads from polingual.photon_edges via PostgREST or a direct query. Cache 5 min. Add getTranslations(id) to polingual/src/lib/photon-db.ts. Acceptance: curl /api/photon/photon:word:en:love/translations returns ≥10 translations across ≥10 languages with 99 in stats.by_lang. Acceptance: pages.

title: P1: word-detail UI panel for translations
description: On /word/<id>, add a collapsible panel "translates to (N languages)" below the meaning section. Each language is a sub-header with the translated photons as clickable chips. Hovering shows the gloss; clicking navigates to the destination photon. Use light-blue palette consistent with current design. Acceptance: visiting https://www.polingual.com/word/photon:word:en:love shows translations in la/es/fr/de/it/pt/ru/zh/ja/ko/ar/etc.

title: P1: polingual.translations denormalised view
description: Build a materialised view polingual.translations with columns (src_lang text, src_surface text, dst_lang text, dst_surface text, src_id text, dst_id text, gloss text, source text) — denormalised for fast lookups by (from_lang, to_lang, surface). B-tree index on (src_lang, dst_lang, lower(src_surface)) and (dst_lang, lower(dst_surface)). Refresh hook on photon_edges insert. Acceptance: SELECT * FROM polingual.translations WHERE src_lang='en' AND dst_lang='la' AND lower(src_surface)='love' returns ≥1 row in <50ms.

title: P1: GET /api/translate?from=en&to=la&q=love endpoint
description: Dedicated translate endpoint. Hits polingual.translations directly. Returns { query, from, to, results: [{ surface, gloss, source_id, dst_id }] }. Acceptance: /api/translate?from=en&to=la&q=love returns latin photons sorted by relevance.

title: P1: install pgvector + add semantic_vec column
description: On agf-supabase-db postgres: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector. Add semantic_vec vector(384) column to polingual.photons. No index yet — that comes after backfill. Acceptance: \d polingual.photons shows semantic_vec column.

title: P1: embed 6.5M photons with bge-small-en-v1.5
description: Run a Python script using sentence-transformers to embed every photon's meaning_en field with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-d). Use a GPU machine (local 4090 if available — server's CPU would take 12+ hours). Batch size 256. Stream results to a CSV (id, vec). Bulk-load to a staging table on the server then UPDATE polingual.photons SET semantic_vec = staging.vec WHERE id = staging.id. Build HNSW index: CREATE INDEX idx_photons_semantic_vec ON polingual.photons USING hnsw (semantic_vec vector_cosine_ops). Acceptance: SELECT count(*) FROM polingual.photons WHERE semantic_vec IS NOT NULL = total_photons.

title: P1: semantic search endpoint + sidecar
description: Build a small Python FastAPI sidecar on agfarms (port 8200, host-only) that exposes POST /embed → 384-d vector. Polingual's /api/photon/search?semantic=... route handler hits the sidecar to embed the query, then runs SELECT * FROM polingual.photons ORDER BY semantic_vec <=> $1 LIMIT k. Add a UI toggle on the homepage: 'match' (current trigram + FTS) vs 'meaning' (semantic). Acceptance: searching 'wisdom' in semantic mode returns sa:vidya, grc:sophia, la:sapientia, ar:hikmah etc. in <200ms.

title: P2: IPA char encoder + 64-d phonetic vectors
description: ~1M photons have ipa values. Build a fixed IPA-char vocabulary from the existing dataset. Encode each IPA string as a 64-d bag-of-trigrams (hash trick) or a 1-layer autoencoder trained on the corpus. Store as phonetic_vec vector(64) on polingual.photons. HNSW index with vector_cosine_ops. Acceptance: SELECT * FROM polingual.photons WHERE phonetic_vec IS NOT NULL >= 800,000.

title: P2: GET /api/photon/search?phonetic=... endpoint
description: Accepts either an IPA string or a regular word (in which case we look up its IPA via getPhoton, fall back to a simple grapheme-to-phoneme mapper). Returns photons clustered by phonetic similarity. Surfaces homophones across languages.

title: P1: spec the claim-kind photon shape
description: Update PHOTON-SPEC.md to lock the claim kind: { kind: 'claim', surface: '<the claim sentence>', meaning_en: '<canonical paraphrase>', cites: [<photon-ids|urls>], supports: [<photon-ids>], refutes: [<photon-ids>], branch: ['02-physics', ...], tier: 'canon|functional|edge', provenance: { source, source_uri, page, paragraph_offset, captured_at } }. Add a JSON schema (claim-photon.schema.json) for validation. Document in PHOTON-SPEC.md §4. Acceptance: a sample claim JSON validates against the schema.

title: P1: POST /api/photon/ingest authenticated endpoint
description: Accept either a single photon JSON or an NDJSON stream. Validate against the appropriate kind's schema. Write to a per-request staging table → INSERT … ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING into polingual.photons. Return { ingested, dupes, errors: [...] }. Auth: HMAC header signed by an env-stored shared secret for now; x402-metered access deferred to bkt-roadmap-27. Acceptance: posting 1k claim photons returns ingested=1000 dupes=0; second post returns dupes=1000.

title: P1: first claim ingest — 1,000 canon-tier claims from bucket-canon
description: Hand-pick 1,000 canon-tier claims from gdrive:AGFarms/Nucleus/research/bucket-canon/ (start with 01-mathematics and 02-physics — those have the cleanest source PDFs). For each: extract the claim sentence, mint a photon id (photon:claim:<branch>:<slug>), record cites edges to the source paper photon (or URL), assign branch tags, set tier='canon'. Drive through the ingest endpoint. Acceptance: SELECT count(*) FROM polingual.photons WHERE kind='claim' >= 1000.

title: P1: claim-detail page on polingual.com
description: Different layout from /word/<id>: claim text as h1, cites/supports/refutes shown as adjacent panels (mini-graph), branch chips, provenance link to source PDF/URL with paragraph anchor. Route: /claim/<id>. Auto-detect kind on /word/<id> and redirect to /claim/<id> if kind='claim' (or use a single /photon/<id> that switches on kind). Acceptance: visiting https://www.polingual.com/claim/photon:claim:02-physics:noethers-theorem renders with all relations clickable.

title: P2: Zipf-frequency column for ranking
description: Compute per-language Zipf rank for every surface form using a real frequency corpus (OpenSubtitles 2018 for most langs; Wikipedia frequency for langs without OS coverage). Add frequency real column to polingual.photons. NULL where unknown. Bulk-load via CSV. Acceptance: SELECT count(*) FROM polingual.photons WHERE frequency IS NOT NULL >= 4,000,000 (covers the top 4M).

title: P2: weighted relevance score in search
description: Replace the boolean tier scoring in lib/photon-db.ts with a real weighted score: score = match_kind_weight (exact=1000, prefix=500, contains=200, fts=50) × tier_weight (canon=2.0, functional=1.0, edge=0.5) × log(frequency_rank). Re-rank results in the search route. Acceptance: searching 'water' returns en:water before nl:waterproof which currently dominates.

title: P2: systemd timer for weekly kaikki refresh on agfarms
description: Create /etc/systemd/system/polingual-refresh.service + polingual-refresh.timer (--user=giany) that runs the kaikki bulk pipeline (download-if-newer + parse + load) every Monday 03:00 UTC. Service should be idempotent (load script uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). Log to ~/agfarms/bucket-foundation/_intake/photons/refresh-<date>.log. Acceptance: systemctl --user list-timers polingual-refresh.* shows next run time.

title: P2: refresh diff alerting
description: After each polingual-refresh.service run, compute the delta in SELECT count(*) FROM polingual.photons vs the prior run (stored in a small JSON file). If |new - prior| / prior > 0.05, post a Telegram or Discord webhook alert with the diff. Acceptance: a manual test with a forced 10% bump triggers the webhook.

title: P2: language picker — pin favorites
description: With 35 languages results are noisy. Add a small UI affordance (top-right of the search bar) that opens a popover where the user can pin 3–5 favorite languages. Pinned langs are boosted in scoring (×1.5) and shown first in grouped results. Persist via localStorage. Acceptance: pinning [en, la, grc] causes those three to always sort first in every search.

title: P2: per-word Open Graph cards
description: Add polingual/src/app/word/[id]/opengraph-image.tsx that generates a dynamic OG card for each photon: surface (large), IPA (smaller, monospace, blue), first 120 chars of meaning_en, language flag / code. 1200×630. Acceptance: pasting https://www.polingual.com/word/photon:word:la:amor into Twitter / iMessage shows a rich card.

title: P2: /translate page on polingual.com
description: New route at /translate with from-lang/to-lang dropdowns (defaulting to en→la), a query box, and results from /api/translate. Show source surface + IPA, then target surfaces ranked by relevance, each with gloss + clickable photon link. Same light-blue palette. Acceptance: visiting /translate?from=en&to=la&q=love renders Latin amor at the top.

title: P3: etymology view on word-detail page
description: When etymology edges exist (separate future ingest: parse Wiktionary's etymology_text field), render them as a tree on /word/<id>. Latin amor → Proto-Italic *amō → PIE *h₂em-. Reuse the relations table; predicate='derives_from'. Acceptance: en:love shows a derivation chain back to PIE root.

title: P3: INGEST.md — runbook for adding a new source
description: Author an INGEST.md at repo root that walks through: (1) ingest one-off via POST /api/photon/ingest; (2) ingest a JSONL file; (3) write a new connector like photon-kaikki-bulk3.py for a third-party source (wordnet, etymonline, free dictionaries). Include schema, ID conventions, idempotency notes, dedupe behaviour. Acceptance: a new dev can follow INGEST.md and ingest 100 photons from a CSV in <30 min.

title: P3: OpenAPI spec for /api/photon/*
description: Generate or hand-write polingual/public/api/openapi.json that documents every public endpoint: schema, params, responses, examples. Serve at /api/openapi.json. Acceptance: paste the spec into editor.swagger.io and it validates + lets you 'try it out'.

title: P3: PHOTON-SPEC v0.2 — versioning + changelog
description: Tag the current spec as v0.2 (now includes edges, embeddings, multiple kinds). Add a CHANGELOG section at the bottom. Define backward-compatibility rules: additive fields allowed in patch versions; required-field changes require minor version bump; predicate vocabulary changes require minor bump.

title: P3: wire /api/photon/* to feed402 / x402-research-gateway
description: Per PROTOCOL.md, three tiers: raw / query / insight at $0.010 / $0.005 / $0.002. Polingual photon API becomes the first AGFarms-internal merchant. Add x402 middleware to the route handlers that signs / verifies via Viatika's vendor API or feed402 directly. Free tier for the first N daily queries per IP; metered above. Acceptance: a paid call with a valid Base payment receipt returns the photon; an unpaid call returns a 402 with a payment quote.

title: P3: per-photon citation endpoint
description: GET /api/photon/<id>/cite?format=bibtex|csl-json|jsonld returns a stable citation. Includes the photon id, a content hash of the immutable fields, a captured_at, and a canonical URL. Useful for academic users who want to cite a Bucket photon. Acceptance: the BibTeX output works in LaTeX; the JSON-LD validates against schema.org/CreativeWork.
